name: Acquia Cloud - Backup Manager
description: Applies a retention policy to on-demand Acquia Cloud database backups, deleting older ones by cron via the Cloud API.
project_description:
Back to top 

 INTRODUCTION 
 Acquia Cloud helper for the platform backup management.

If you are using Acquia ACSF watch the module acsf_backup_manager 

 
 This module allows to set a time limit to keep your manual (on-demand) backups on Acquia Cloud, deleting by cron the older ones. 
 
 Based on the API documentation on Acquia Cloud API Documentation 

 Back to top 

 REQUIREMENTS 
 This module requires the Acquia Cloud API access, you should generate an API key.

 Read the Acquia documentation to generate it 

 Also it requires the API library acquia-php-sdk-v2 on version 2.

 Back to top 

 INSTALLATION 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module.

 Back to top 

 CONFIGURATION 
 It has a configuration page in "Configuration / Web Services / Acquia Cloud - Backup Manager Settings"

 Back to top
